    feat(goal): enforce shared execution authorization
    
    Summary:
    - gate implementation and derived repair cycles on the latest approved Goal
      execution projection
    - enforce aggregate windows and attempt, token, and cost ceilings while
      freezing scope at 75 percent
    - cap specialist repair review cycles at two and cover pause/resume behavior
    
    Rationale:
    - one immutable Goal approval must authorize included and strictly derived
      work without allowing restarts to replenish aggregate budgets
    - scope expansion and higher ceilings must stop at one durable Goal decision
      boundary
